sentences.text: Kingdom Hearts III is an upcoming action role-playing game developed and published by Square Enix for the PlayStation 4 and Xbox One .	Square Enix	Square Enix	Kingdom Hearts	Kingdom Hearts	PlayStation 4	PlayStation 4	Xbox One	Xbox One	action role-playing game	action role-playing game

It is the twelfth installment in the Kingdom Hearts series , sequel to Kingdom Hearts II , and the final chapter in the Dark Seeker saga .	Kingdom Hearts	Kingdom Hearts	Kingdom Hearts II	Kingdom Hearts II

Set after the events of Kingdom Hearts 3D : Dream Drop Distance , returning protagonist Sora is joined by Donald Duck , Goofy , King Mickey and Riku in their search for the seven guardians of light and the `` Key to Return Hearts '' as they attempt to thwart Master Xehanort 's plan to bring about a second Keyblade War .	Kingdom Hearts	Kingdom Hearts	Sora	Sora (Kingdom Hearts)	Donald Duck	Donald Duck	Goofy	Goofy	King Mickey	Mickey Mouse	Riku	Riku (Kingdom Hearts)	Master Xehanort	Xehanort
Their journey has them cross paths with characters , and visit worlds , based on Disney properties and Final Fantasy .	Disney	The Walt Disney Company	Final Fantasy	Final Fantasy

Concepts for the game began as early as 2006 , after the release of Kingdom Hearts II : Final Mix in Japan , with the game not officially confirmed to be in development until E3 2013 , after years of rumors and speculation .	Kingdom Hearts	Kingdom Hearts	Kingdom Hearts II	Kingdom Hearts II	E3 2013	E3 2013

Kingdom Hearts III sees many returning gameplay features from the series , while introducing new `` Attraction Flow '' attacks that incorporate Disney Parks attractions .	Kingdom Hearts	Kingdom Hearts	Disney	The Walt Disney Company	Disney Parks	Walt Disney Parks and Resorts
The game also is the first in the series to utilize Unreal Engine 4 .	Unreal Engine 4	Unreal Engine 4
